courses.summary: 以多金伯利岩管的大型鑽石露天礦為例，研究採運、品質追溯與資源使用。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
courses.summaryEn: A large multi-pipe diamond open pit examines hauling, quality traceability and resource use. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.

courses.connectionEn: Cycle-time changes as the pit deepens; Representativeness for sparse high-value particles; Tradeoffs between size control and excessive breakage
